Class TicTacToeGame

java.lang.Object
TicTacToeGame
public class TicTacToeGame extends Object
Represents the state and logic of a Tic-Tac-Toe game. The board is stored as a flat array of 9 cells (index 0..8), read left-to-right, top-to-bottom. Registered GameListeners are notified on moves, game-over, and reset.

  • Method Details

    • reset

      public void reset()
      Resets the board to an empty state and sets X as the starting player. All registered listeners are notified via GameListener.onReset(TicTacToeGame.Mark).

    • getBoard

      public TicTacToeGame.Mark[] getBoard()
      Returns a defensive copy of the board array. Index 0 is top-left; index 8 is bottom-right.
      Returns:
      a 9-element array of TicTacToeGame.Mark values

    • getCurrent

      public TicTacToeGame.Mark getCurrent()
      Returns the mark of the player whose turn it currently is.
      Returns:
      TicTacToeGame.Mark.X or TicTacToeGame.Mark.O

    • isGameOver

      public boolean isGameOver()
      Returns whether the game has ended (win or draw).
      Returns:
      true if the game is over

    • getWinner

      public TicTacToeGame.Mark getWinner()
      Returns the winner of the game. If the game is still in progress, this returns TicTacToeGame.Mark.EMPTY. If the game ended in a draw, this also returns TicTacToeGame.Mark.EMPTY.
      Returns:
      the winning TicTacToeGame.Mark, or EMPTY for draw/in-progress

    • play

      public boolean play(int index)
      Attempts to play at the given board index for the current player. The move is rejected if the game is over, the index is out of bounds, or the cell is already occupied. On a valid move, listeners are notified. If the move ends the game, GameListener.onGameOver(TicTacToeGame.Mark) is fired.
      Parameters:
      index - the cell to play (0..8)
      Returns:
      true if the move was accepted, false otherwise

    • legalMoves

      public List<Integer> legalMoves()
      Returns the list of board indices that are still available to play. Returns an empty list if the game is over.
      Returns:
      list of legal move indices (0..8)
